import Foundation

func work(_ item: Int) async {}
func save(_ item: Int) async throws {}

final class Runner {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []

  // CASE generic_block_comment expect=pass
  func a() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task<Void, Never> {
          /* we don't wait */
          await work(item)
        })
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_two_apostrophes expect=pass
  func b() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task<Void, Never> {
          // it's fine, we don't wait
          await work(item)
        })
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_multiline_string expect=pass
  func c() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(
        Task<Void, Never> {
          let note = """
            item \(item)
            """
          print(note)
          await work(item)
        })
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_error_comment expect=pass
  func d() {
    for item in items {
      let t = Task<Void, Error> {
        // Don't retry here.
        try await save(item)
      }
      _ = t
    }
  }

  // CASE group_priority_operation expect=pass
  func e() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask(
          priority: .high,
          operation: {
            await work(item)
          })
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE group_unless_operation expect=pass
  func f() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        _ = group.addTaskUnlessCancelled(operation: {
          await work(item)
        })
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE throwing_group_operation expect=pass
  func g() async throws {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask(operation: { try await save(item) })
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }

  // CASE task_operation_capture expect=pass
  func h() {
    for item in items {
      Task(operation: { [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      })
    }
  }

  // CASE group_operation_sibling expect=fire
  func i() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask(operation: { await work(item) })
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE nongeneric_comment expect=pass
  func j() {
    for item in items {
      Task {
        // don't block
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }

  func go(_ item: Int) async {}
}
